annotations.title: Etsy shop sales count (paused: Etsy's API unavailable)

description: PAUSED: Growtsy can't read Etsy's API right now (since 19 November 2026); this tool returns the error etsy_offline — don't retry it. Instead: etsy_seller_answer ("How can I see how many sales an Etsy shop has?" — every open shop page shows # Sales). When Etsy access returns: Etsy's own sales count (transaction_sold_count: total sales of the shop, not per listing), active listings, favorites and opening year for up to 5 Etsy shops. No revenue estimate. Use for 'how many sales does this Etsy shop have?' and comparing competitors. If Growtsy has read a shop before, `history` gives the change in Etsy's sales count since that first read, with its date and number of days (the difference of two Etsy counts, not an estimate).

shops.description: Up to 5 Etsy shop names or links, as an array or a comma-separated string
